verdict.rationale: Mem0 lets you delete individual memories via the CLI and set an expiration_date on memories, and self-hosting gives full ownership of the data. However, expiration only stops a memory from surfacing; the docs explicitly say 'Nothing is deleted.' That makes it a visibility control rather than true retention-based deletion. Missing for 10: automatic hard deletion on expiry, documented platform-side retention policies or deletion guarantees (bulk or account-level erasure), and independent hands-on corroboration.
